subject: general
question: In__________, Swami Dayananda Saraswati opened a branch of the Arya Samaj at Lahore.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1877**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Arya samaj was** **founded by the** sannyasi (ascetic) Dayanand Saraswati on 7 April 1877 at Lahore.**
 
• Arya Samaj was the first Hindu organization to introduce** proselytization in Hinduism.** 
 
• The organization has also worked towards** the growth of the civil rights movement in India since the 1800s.**
 
• Swami Dayanand established the Arya Samaj on April 7, 1875 in Bombay, with 10 principles that are beautifully based purely on** God, soul and nature.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Arya samaj, brought about immense changes in the religious perceptions of Indians.
 
• **Maharshi Dayanand Saraswati** was an Indian philosopher, social leader and founder of the Arya Samaj, a reform movement of the Vedic dharma.
 
• He was the first to give the call for** Swaraj as "India for Indians" in 1876.**
